headline: 9-hour power outage planned for Thursday in several areas
summary: Certain regions across Bangladesh will face significant electricity disruptions on Thursday as part of scheduled maintenance.
details: Several areas across the country are set to experience power outages lasting up to 9 hours this Thursday.
The outages are part of scheduled maintenance work on the electricity grid to ensure long-term stability.
Residents in the affected areas are advised to make necessary preparations for the prolonged disruption.
The authorities have announced the schedule to allow businesses and households to plan accordingly.

headline: Govt meeting held on pay scale review for employees
summary: A secretary-level committee has convened to discuss updates to the government's pay scale, focusing on potential adjustments for public servants.
details: A secretary-level committee of the government has held a meeting to discuss the revision of the national pay scale for government employees.
The meeting focused on evaluating current salary structures and considering the necessary adjustments to meet the current economic conditions.
The committee is tasked with reviewing the pay scales to ensure fair compensation for public servants across various grades.
Further details regarding the specific changes or the final implementation date of the new pay scale are expected to be announced following the committee's review process.
caption:
Is a new pay scale coming? A government committee has met to discuss salary revisions for employees.

A secretary-level committee of the government has held a meeting to discuss the revision of the national pay scale for government employees.

Further details regarding the specific changes or the final implementation date of the new pay scale are expected to be announced following the committee's review process.
